summary: The persistence layer changes clearly introduce separate localStorage keys for user-default vs active/edited Callaway grid charts and describe the required fallback/initialization behavior. However, the CallawayChartEditor save/reset wiring is truncated in the diff, so it’s not fully evidenced that “Save Changes” updates user-defaults and that “Reset to Defaults” restores from those user-defaults.

missing_requirements.requirement: When a user saves changes in the Callaway Chart Editor, persist the saved 9-hole and 18-hole grid charts as the new default chart values in localStorage so future loads and “Reset to Defaults” use those saved values (and initialize defaults from hard-coded when missing).
missing_requirements.reason: The editor file shows new imports for `saveGridChartAsDefault` and `resetGridChartToUserDefaults`, but the actual `handleSave` / reset implementation is truncated, so the diff summary does not provide explicit evidence that clicking “Save Changes” writes the saved chart into the new user-default localStorage keys for both 9 and 18, nor that “Reset to Defaults” loads from those user-defaults.
